{{Otheruses|Curse}}
The '''Curse of Graush''' was term for the physical and mental changes that a being possessed by the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]] experienced. Sometime before the year [[7000 BBY]], [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[King/Legends|King]] Dathka Graush had his [[Heart/Legends|heart]] replaced by a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Heart of Graush|crystal]] using [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] and the most advanced technology. After Graush's assassination, the crystal was buried along side his remains in [[Dathka Graush's tomb|his tomb]] in [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban's]] [[Valley of Golg]].

Exactly six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], [[Naz Felyood]], disturbed Graush's crystal heart and was briefly possessed by Graush's spirit. The experience caused his body to stop aging. Felyood also healed ten times faster than an average being and become highly resistant to physical damage from energy weapons, [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]], and most other melee weapons. Furthermore, the residual dark side energy allowed Felyood to be able to speak, read, and write ancient [[Sith (language)|Sith]].
